array_flight_lab.name: Fly into the third index
array_flight_lab.description: 64 familiar pickup cubes spaced 2.4m apart in the existing 12m Menger glass flight enclosure. X/Y/Z controls select a slot; collecting records zero without shifting its address.
array_flight_lab.qfep_connection: A repeated rule makes an address, a field or an environment; the receiver and body determine what can be encountered.
